reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, and if it really looks clean with the cleaning log and shoes off, I'd come a couple more times on a weekday morning since I'm always looking for somewhere to go with the kids. It's not a regular thing at $13 a visit on my budget.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth. And $13 a visit adds up fast on one income, a few visits a month is about all I can do.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in person on the free visit and it being truly clean; a cheaper weekday price or a pack under $50 would make me come more often.
